purpose: Test whether frozen near/far visitor histories rotate joint local selection on floral investment i and reproductive assurance a toward a classic island-syndrome vector using rare-mutant invasion fitness, then validate the parental-fitness accounting with an exact multivariate Price identity.

invasion_fitness.definition: rare mutant expected parental genome contribution in a monomorphic resident background
invasion_fitness.components: 0.5 * mutant maternal outcross + 0.5 * mutant paternal outcross + mutant viable selfed seed
invasion_fitness.selfed_transmission: selfed seed contributes both maternal and paternal halves, hence one full parental-genome equivalent
invasion_fitness.resident_environment: resident pollen pool and resident female return held fixed to first order in mutant frequency
invasion_fitness.derivative: central finite difference of log invasion fitness with mutant trait changed and resident traits fixed

vector_definitions.classic_sign_reversal: near beta_i >= +0.05 AND near beta_a <= -0.05 AND far beta_i <= -0.05 AND far beta_a >= +0.05
vector_definitions.report_both: a directional shift is not promoted to a sign reversal

predictions_before_execution.delayed_control: near-to-far joint shift expected, but positive beta_a is structural and not counted as independent assurance evidence
predictions_before_execution.prior_selfing: near-to-far joint shift expected; assurance sign reversal is plausible because prior selfing discounts outcrossable ovules
predictions_before_execution.pollen_discount: near-to-far joint shift expected; near beta_a should move negative because assurance reduces paternal outcross success
predictions_before_execution.assurance_cost: near-to-far joint shift expected; an internal assurance optimum or near-negative/far-positive region is plausible
predictions_before_execution.no_requirement: the three tradeoff settings need not share the same absolute endpoint or sign-reversal prevalence

price_validation.conditions: mutation=0, immigration=0, survival=0, additive expressed traits
price_validation.identity: mean(z)_{t+1}=mean(z)_t+Cov(z,w)/mean(w), using total parental genome contribution w including maternal, paternal and double self transmission

trajectory_promotion.rule: Run multi-generation evolving-assurance trajectories only for tradeoff settings that pass the joint gradient-shift gate; keep delayed_control as a control.
trajectory_promotion.realized_vector: far-minus-near endpoint investment <= -0.01 AND far-minus-near endpoint assurance >= +0.01
trajectory_promotion.alternative_endpoints: if multiple attractor-like endpoints appear, report dependence on initial state/history and do not label them universal attractors

fixed_delta_boundary: Inbreeding depression remains fixed; no purging feedback is represented. Any alternative endpoints are conditional on fixed delta.
novelty_boundary: Do not claim a new general selfing threshold.
Do not claim the automatic advantage of selfing as new.
Do not claim bimodal mating-system evolution as new.
Novelty, if supported, is the joint i-a selection field generated by the same visitor-transfer operator and its effect on repeatability/history dependence.
